title: Estimate Upload, Customer Contact and Insurer Update Standards (Insurer Program Agreements)
content:
The service standards below apply to centers repairing for an insurer that holds one of the Insurer Program Agreements, and differ by the agreement's tier.

| Agreement tier | Estimate upload (hours after inspection) | Photos with each estimate | Customer contact (hours after assignment) | Insurer status updates (every n business days) | Manufacturer position statements attached |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 24 | 8 | 4 | 2 | Yes |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 24 | 10 | 4 | 2 | Yes |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 12 | 12 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 8 | 16 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 8 | 16 | 2 | 1 | Yes |

## What each standard measures

- **Estimate upload** — the hours after inspection within which the estimate and photos are uploaded to the insurer (a whole number of hours; 0 means not applicable).
- **Photos with each estimate** — the photos uploaded with each estimate (a whole number; 0 means not applicable).
- **Customer contact** — the hours after an assignment within which the customer is contacted (a whole number of hours; 0 means not applicable).
- **Insurer status updates** — the business days between repair status updates to the insurer (a whole number; 0 means not applicable).
- **Manufacturer position statements** — whether manufacturer position statements are attached when a repair method or calibration is questioned.

## Zero entries

Every 0 in the Network Referral Agreement row means the standard is not applicable to that tier; it is not a standard of zero hours, zero photos or zero days. The position statement standard has no zero value and reads "Yes" in every tier.

## Illustration (hypothetical times)

Under a Premier Direct Repair Agreement, a vehicle inspected at 9:00 on a given day has its estimate and 12 photos uploaded to the insurer within 12 hours, that is by 21:00 that day; a customer whose assignment arrives at 14:00 is contacted within 2 hours, that is by 16:00. Under a Select Direct Repair Agreement the same inspection allows 24 hours and 8 photos, and the contact allows 4 hours. The clock times are invented for the illustration.
